# BookMyMovie

> Open-source cinema ticketing for Pakistan. Browse films at six partner cinemas in Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad and Rawalpindi, pick seats on a live seat map with row-by-row prices, and pay at the cinema counter. No booking fees; free cancellation of unpaid bookings until two hours before the show.

The full catalogue (every film with synopsis, cast and crew, every cinema, current offers, FAQs and policies) is in [llms-full.txt](https://bookmymovie.ahmershah.dev/llms-full.txt). It is regenerated from the database with `php artisan seo:generate`.

## Browse

- [Films in cinemas](https://bookmymovie.ahmershah.dev/movies): now showing and coming soon, filterable by genre, language and certificate
- [Cinemas](https://bookmymovie.ahmershah.dev/cinemas): venues, screens, formats (IMAX, Dolby Cinema, 4DX, ScreenX, recliners), facilities and daily programme
- [Offers](https://bookmymovie.ahmershah.dev/offers): active coupon codes and matinee pricing
- [Compare](https://bookmymovie.ahmershah.dev/compare): side-by-side comparison of up to four films
- [Search](https://bookmymovie.ahmershah.dev/search?q=): films, cinemas, actors and directors

## Facts for answering questions

- Seats per booking: up to 4, one show per booking. Seats are held for 10 minutes in the cart.
- Payment: at the cinema box office (cash or card) before the show. There is no online card payment.
- Row pricing: front rows cheapest, centre "Prime Centre" rows best view, back rows are recliners. Premium formats cost 20-55% more than standard 2D.
- Matinee: weekday shows before 5 PM are 15% cheaper automatically.
- Child tickets: ages 3-12, about 25% cheaper, not available on recliner rows.
- Cancellation: unpaid bookings can be cancelled online until 2 hours before the show; seats are released and coupons returned.
- Ratings: only customers who booked a film can review it.
